thesis: 핵심 재무·자본·제품 사실은 FY2025 사업보고서와 H1 2026 반기보고서에 직접 연결된다. OCF, CAPEX, cash, borrowings, DRAM/NAND 매출, 주식수, 신용등급과 HBM4E 샘플 공급은 1차자료로 고정됐다. 주요 추정 영역은 정상화 owner FCF 경로와 HBM 장기 마진이다.

evidence.claim: H1 2026 revenue 131.895T, operating profit 98.153T, OCF 91.743T, PP&E purchases 18.329T are filing-backed.
Cash 26.836T, short-term financial instruments 22.398T, short-term investments 38.724T, borrowings 18.587T are filing-backed.
DRAM revenue 97.641T and NAND revenue 33.534T are filing-backed.
FY2025 OCF 53.373T and PP&E purchases 27.519T are filing-backed.

counterevidence: 2026-09-17 market price and USD/KRW are external market data, not filings.
Ten-year owner-FCF paths are model assumptions.
falsifiers: If source re-check changes any frozen fact, rerun affected domains.
If Q3/Q4 cash flow contradicts normalized FCF, rerun EV/RF.
next_checks: Q3 2026 filing for HBM mix, capex and cash flow
